title: Mutating one of two possibly shared int arrays
summary: The reference writes through the left root and the alternative skips that write. Three independent claims observe the return value, the right root, or both final arrays.

change.description: The deliberate alternative returns zero without making the write.

notes: Each root is null or an array of zero to two binary cells. Equal contents permit both shared and distinct identities.

The original integrated JBMC preservation attempt stopped at two generated catch handlers. On the same class digests and full 71-heap domain, JBMC now establishes the preserving pair and refutes the skipped write with a JVM replay of both selected roots. The observer retains writes made before an exception. Selecting the right root alone forces a shared witness. The nine-heap distinct-root profile preserves the right root even when the left write differs, including two separately allocated [0] arrays. The separately keyed four-heap profile and the three original native receipts are also decided.

The fast-follow regression repeated the original native tasks at array bound two and unwind eight with the same classpaths and JDK. All 71 direct heaps per revision reproduced the original disagreements. Return preservation was established, and the right-root and both-root violations replayed on the JVM. [Regression job](../../verification/results/20261120-042933-recheck-both-array-roots-after-the-fast/result.json)

The numerical checker repeated all three original native verdicts. The reference and skipped-write JVM grids had the same digests as the preceding 71-heap run. [Array-root regression](../../verification/results/20261120-053727-confirm-both-array-roots-after-the-numer/result.json)

The language and list changes retained the three original array-root results at unwind eight and array bound two. All 71 direct heaps on each revision have the prior JVM stream digests. Both distinct poststate witnesses reproduced.

After the JDK map, reader and stream changes, all three original 197 outcomes were rechecked at array bound 2 and unwind 8. Both wrong poststates reproduced independently and all 71 direct JVM rows on each side retained their original hashes. [Final three-claim job](../../verification/results/20261120-083146-recheck-the-two-array-roots-after-sequen/result.json)
